set.body:
WHY: storymodel4s consumes grakern by immutable SHA ProjectRef (with -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build override). Workspace policy prefers published artifacts; the release also proves that grakern builds from a clean clone with its own pins.

SCOPE: 0.1.0-M1 tag; graph4s and gale pins resolved to published artifacts if available, otherwise documented immutable SHAs with a clean-clone CI job; CHANGELOG; README maturity update; packages.toml publication state updated by the workspace tool.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Clean-clone CI job (no sibling checkouts, no local overrides) runs scalafmtCheckAll compileAll testAll on JVM/JS/Native and passes.
2. Transitive pin set (graph4s SHA, gale SHA) is recorded in a build receipt file committed with the tag and matches what storymodel4s records.
3. Artifacts for core, standard, graph4s adapter, laws published (Maven Central or the workspace's local repository as the policy allows); engine-jvm published for JVM.
4. Discipline laws (previous bead) and parity fixtures green at the tagged commit.

PROPOSED TESTS
- .github/workflows/clean-clone.yml: fresh runner, `git clone` at tag, full court.
- ReceiptSuite: the committed pin receipt equals the values in build.sbt (parsed), failing the build on drift.
